title: Incorporate a source into Annals knowledge
summary: Have Annals' AI reader compare one retained source with the current evidence-backed idea map, then retain the proposed result or apply it when authorized.
use_when: Immutable source material should be examined against the evidence-backed conceptual corpus.
An already retained work should be deliberately integrated or reexamined at current HEAD.
do_not_use_when: Only unchanged source retention is wanted.
The requested result is a summary, truth judgment, action backlog, or generic semantic search.
The user has not authorized immediate application of a material proposed corpus change.
outcome: A durable examination and reconciliation for one work at one frozen base revision, left pending, applied by explicit request, or recorded with no corpus change.
effects: May retain a new immutable work and always creates or reuses model-run and reconciliation provenance for the selected context.
Submits a constrained Nucleus job and may consume Codex account allowance.
Without `--apply`, a material projected change remains pending; with `--apply`, it atomically creates a commit and advances HEAD.
A mechanically equal projected state is recorded without a commit or revision advance.
authority: Annals owns works, the frozen base revision, draft validation, reconciliation records, projected corpus state, application, and domain success.
Nucleus owns only execution, authentication, job state, and raw protocol history; final model prose is diagnostic.
success: Annals records exactly one valid reconciliation or an exact-context reusable reconciliation is selected.
When application is requested, Annals reports an applied revision and its invariants remain valid.
When no material change results, the interpretation is durably recorded with no corpus revision change.
failure_and_recovery: The liaison may revise named draft operations until the complete request resolves; independently valid operations remain staged.
A pending reconciliation applies only while HEAD still equals its base revision.
If Nucleus fails after Annals records the domain result, preserve that result and do not infer failure from the runtime alone.
privacy: The complete selected source and relevant frozen corpus context may be included in the Nucleus request and retained in Nucleus operational state.
Annals and Nucleus state belong inside the same private retention boundary for this operation.
does_not_authorize: Applying a material reconciliation unless `--apply` or a separate explicit apply request is authorized.
Treating the provisional concept decomposition as uniquely correct or objectively true.
Publishing or disclosing the source or corpus.
